text.zh-CN:
囊性纤维化是遗传性疾病，使体内黏液过于黏稠，主要影响肺和消化系统。

- 黏液堵塞气道，可造成长期咳嗽和反复胸部感染。
- 胰腺消化液难以到达肠道，可导致体重增长差和油腻大便。
text.en:
Cystic fibrosis is an inherited disorder causing unusually thick mucus, mainly affecting lungs and digestion.

- Blocked airways cause persistent cough and repeated chest infections.
- Blocked pancreatic secretions impair digestion, causing poor weight gain and greasy stools.

text.zh-CN:
基因变化影响细胞调节盐和水的蛋白。

- 通常需从父母双方各遗传一个致病基因变异。
- 只携带一个变异的父母可能完全没有症状。
- 疾病本身不会通过接触传染，但患者可相互传播某些肺部感染。
text.en:
Gene changes affect a protein that regulates salt and water.

- A disease-causing variant is usually inherited from each parent.
- Parents carrying one variant may have no symptoms.
- The disease is not contagious, although patients can transmit certain lung infections to one another.

text.zh-CN:
与平时不同的严重症状需要急评。

- 明显呼吸困难、发青或意识改变应呼叫急救。
- 大量咯血或突然剧烈胸痛，需排查出血或气胸。
- 剧烈腹痛、腹胀和呕吐需排查肠道堵塞。
text.en:
Severe changes from baseline need urgent assessment.

- Marked breathlessness, blue colour or altered awareness requires emergency help.
- Heavy coughing of blood or sudden severe chest pain needs assessment for bleeding or a collapsed lung.
- Severe abdominal pain, swelling and vomiting may indicate intestinal blockage.

text.zh-CN:
早期联系专科可避免拖延加重。

- 咳嗽、痰量或气促增加，发热、食欲下降时联系照护团队。
- 儿童增长落后、反复胸部感染或长期油腻便，应讨论检查。
- 按专科计划定期复查，即使当前感觉良好。
text.en:
Early contact with the specialist team helps address deterioration.

- Report increased cough, sputum or breathlessness, fever and reduced appetite.
- Poor growth, recurrent chest infections or persistent greasy stools in children warrant testing discussions.
- Keep specialist reviews even when feeling well.

text.zh-CN:
筛查和确诊检查的用途不同。

- 新生儿血点筛查可提示风险，阳性不等于单独确诊。
- 汗液检查测盐分，基因检测寻找相关变异。
- 肺功能、痰培养和营养评估用于了解影响程度，不是只查一次即可结束。
text.en:
Screening and diagnostic tests have different purposes.

- Newborn blood-spot screening identifies risk rather than independently confirming disease.
- Sweat testing measures salt and genetic testing identifies relevant variants.
- Lung function, sputum cultures and nutrition assessments monitor impact over time.

text.zh-CN:
反复咳嗽或生长差并不只见于本病。

- 哮喘可喘息，但不通常解释胰腺消化不良和油腻便。
- 其他支气管扩张或免疫问题也可反复感染。
- 营养吸收障碍有多种原因，需要结合汗液和基因结果判断。
text.en:
Recurrent cough or poor growth is not unique to this condition.

- Asthma causes wheeze but does not usually explain pancreatic maldigestion and greasy stools.
- Other bronchiectasis or immune disorders also cause repeated infections.
- Malabsorption has several causes; sweat and genetic findings need clinical interpretation.

text.zh-CN:
治疗需要长期多专业协作。

- 排痰技术和吸入治疗帮助清除黏液，抗生素处理相应感染。
- 胰酶和营养支持改善食物消化及体重。
- 适合特定基因变异者可用调节蛋白功能的药，晚期部分患者需肺移植。
text.en:
Treatment requires long-term multidisciplinary care.

- Airway clearance and inhaled treatments move mucus, with antibiotics for appropriate infections.
- Pancreatic enzymes and nutritional support improve digestion and weight.
- Protein-modulator medicines benefit eligible genetic variants; selected advanced cases need lung transplantation.

text.zh-CN:
不同药物针对不同环节。

- 稀化黏液药帮助排痰，不能代替排痰训练或治疗所有感染。
- 胰酶随食物按专科方案使用，量不足可继续油腻便，不能自行大量加药。
- CFTR是帮助细胞调节盐和水的蛋白；调节这种蛋白的药只适合特定基因变异，可能有药物相互作用及情绪等副作用，需专科随访。
text.en:
Medicines act on different parts of the disease.

- Mucus-thinning treatments support clearance but do not replace clearance techniques or treat every infection.
- Use pancreatic enzymes with food according to the specialist plan; persistent greasy stools warrant review rather than uncontrolled increases.
- CFTR is a protein regulating salt and water; medicines modifying it require eligible variants and follow-up for drug interactions and adverse effects, including mood changes.

text.zh-CN:
营养建议要根据消化吸收、体重和治疗变化调整。

- 有吸收不良或体重不足者常需更多能量并配合胰酶。
- 特定维生素补充及盐分需求由团队评估，不能照搬普通减脂食谱。
- 合并糖尿病或使用有效调节药后体重增加者，饮食需要重新调整。
text.en:
Nutrition follows absorption, weight and treatment changes.

- Malabsorption or low weight may require more energy alongside enzymes.
- The team assesses vitamin and salt needs; standard weight-loss diets may be unsuitable.
- Diabetes or weight gain after effective modulator therapy requires reassessment.

text.zh-CN:
规律完成日常治疗有助减少黏液积聚。

- 按理疗师教的方法排痰，清洁并晾干吸入设备。
- 安排适合的活动，记录咳嗽、体重和大便变化。
- 遵守专科的患者间接触及感染控制建议，不共用设备。
text.en:
Regular daily treatment limits mucus accumulation.

- Use taught clearance techniques and clean and dry inhalation equipment.
- Maintain suitable activity and track cough, weight and stool changes.
- Follow specialist advice on patient-to-patient contact and infection control; do not share equipment.

text.zh-CN:
不同阶段需要不同支持。

- 婴幼儿重点关注喂养、生长和感染。
- 青少年需逐渐学会独立用药和过渡到成人服务。
- 计划妊娠者应提前讨论肺功能、营养、遗传及药物；男性可能需要生育专科帮助。
text.en:
Care changes across life stages.

- Infants need attention to feeding, growth and infection.
- Adolescents need support learning self-management and moving to adult services.
- Pregnancy planning includes lung health, nutrition, genetics and medicines; men may require fertility support.

text.zh-CN:
病程因基因、感染和治疗反应而异。

- 目前通常不能根治，但治疗可明显改善生活和长期结局。
- 定期检查肺功能、微生物、营养以及糖尿病或肝病等问题。
- 新药改变病情后仍要复查，不能自行停掉其他治疗。
text.en:
Course varies with genetics, infection and treatment response.

- There is generally no cure, but treatment can substantially improve life and outcomes.
- Reviews assess lung function, microbes, nutrition, diabetes and liver disease.
- Continue reassessment after new medicines; do not independently stop other treatments.

text.zh-CN:
黏液堵塞会影响多个器官。

- 反复感染可形成支气管扩张，即气道永久变宽并更难排痰。
- 胰腺受损可引起消化不良或相关糖尿病。
- 部分人出现肠梗阻、肝病、骨密度下降或生育问题，需要针对性随访。
text.en:
Mucus obstruction can affect several organs.

- Repeated infection can cause bronchiectasis: permanently widened airways that clear mucus poorly.
- Pancreatic damage causes maldigestion or related diabetes.
- Some develop intestinal blockage, liver disease, weaker bones or fertility problems needing targeted care.

text.zh-CN:
遗传病不能靠生活方式预防，但能降低可避免的损伤。

- 有家族史或生育计划者可接受遗传咨询及适当携带者检测。
- 避免烟雾，接种推荐疫苗并遵守感染控制。
- 坚持排痰、营养和复诊，目标是减少加重而非保证不再感染。
text.en:
Lifestyle cannot prevent the inherited condition, but avoidable damage can be reduced.

- Family history or pregnancy planning may warrant genetic counselling and carrier testing.
- Avoid smoke, receive recommended vaccines and follow infection control.
- Maintain clearance, nutrition and reviews to reduce exacerbations rather than guarantee freedom from infection.
